mechanism: Sulfamethoxazole may displace torsemide from protein binding and both drugs undergo renal elimination, increasing torsemide concentration and diuretic effect; sulfamethoxazole also inhibits renal tubular secretion of organic anions.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and fluid status; adjust torsemide dose if necessary and monitor for signs of excessive diuresis or hypokalemia.
